description:
A two-summer, mentor-guided research-training experience at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health focused on aging research — Alzheimer's disease and related dementias — and on addressing health disparities. Builds research competencies and professional skills for undergraduates in MSTEM (medicine, science, technology, engineering, math) fields, especially students underrepresented in aging research.
